## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated (regression test for bug fixes; two-user test for anything personal)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (tests, build, live end-to-end)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/API.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md`, `docs/SOCIAL.md`, `.env.example`, … as relevant)
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env`, no large binaries committed
- [ ] Authorisation is enforced on the server (not only hidden in the UI)
- [ ] Free/Pro rules unchanged, or updated in `README.md`, `docs/SOCIAL.md` and `server/routes/plan.js`
